card.name: Comparisons right after 'similar to'
card.fires_on: Words in or just after a comparison phrase such as 'similar to', 'comparable to', 'something like' or 'meets', where a comparison target is about to be named. Seen in general web text.

modes.label: Linking word in a comparison
modes.example: A fuel cell is a device similar<< to>> a battery in that it converts chemical energy

modes.label: Noun ending the compared item
modes.description: A noun or word piece within the comparison phrase, before or inside the thing being compared to.
modes.example: Washington's nine ESDs are similar to regional support<< systems>> in other states struggling to stretch limited dollars

card.writes: It suppresses 'similar' and 'like' words, so it seems to stop a comparison word from being repeated once one has been used.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of 'X is similar to Y' comparisons, just as the thing being compared is about to be named.
